messages:
Maya: Sneaker swap happening today by the whiteboard at 4pm. Bring mismatched pairs! :athletic_shoe:
Sam: I'm bringing a pair that only runs to the left. They have opinions.
Eli: Will there be a size chart or just interpretive fitting? :thinking_face:
Jun: Quick one-liner contest: best shoe pun gets temporary naming rights of the lost umbrella in the lobby.
Maya: "Shoe did what it had to do."
Sam: "These kicks are my sole-mates." :sweat_smile:
Eli: "Umbrella? Never met her. I'm a-boot to find out."
LostAndFoundBot: Lost item logged: navy umbrella w/ yellow handle. Claimed items: none. Claim here: https://tiny.redwood/lost/2794321987
Jun: Vote with reactions: :trophy: for Maya, :sparkles: for Sam, :zap: for Eli.
Sam: Also kudos to @Eli for rescuing the conference plant on Tuesday. :seedling:
Eli: That was a team effort (and a paper towel).
Maya: Sneaker swap reminder: please label your shoes if you take home someone else's. We had a swap mystery last month.
Jun: Winner of the pun contest is Sam by unanimous emoji. Umbrella naming rights go to Sam: "The Yellow Diplomat."
LostAndFoundBot: Reminder: Items not claimed within 30 days will be donated. :box_with_heart:
Maya: See you at 4pm. Bring puns, not just socks. :socks:
